problems.title: Bleeding 1 -> 3 rounds reaches five more techniques (and probably Open Vein) that the builder does not list, and no rules-table line pins them
problems.evidence: The builder lists Cleave and the Cruelty feeling as what moved (9 rules-table lines). The same call shape `cond(t, target, 'bleeding')` with no rounds (physical/core.ts:492 -> applyCond with rounds undefined) is also used by Cut's critical (physical/melee/strikes.ts:12), Sweep's critical (strikes.ts:77), Sunder on an Edge weapon (strikes.ts:137), Draw Cut on every Edge hit (openers.ts:186) and Pull Out (strikes-b.ts:211). Old flagCond: ca.rounds = rounds || 1, then `ca.rounds || 3` = 1; new: def.rounds = 3. So each of those went from 5 to 15 bleed damage as well. rules-techniques.json has `bleed0>` only on the six tech/cleave lines, so the tables neither show nor pin the other five. data/weapon_mastery.json:554 (open_vein, a `condition: bleeding` effect with no rounds) takes the same path if it is run by the generic op (not run). Spec item 1561(a) and the hand-off name only Cleave, Cruelty and the story carry.

problems.title: Unlisted live change: Mind Without Fog no longer blocks Witnessed and Hopeful; spec item 1565 says no trait or perk changed
problems.evidence: Throwaway test, same code on both commits: a character with trait mind_without_fog (immunity to heart_debuff), applyCond with skipSave. At d3f6b58: witnessed -> 'is untouched (Mind Without Fog)', hopeful -> 'is untouched (Mind Without Fog)'. At 61f9a99: 'is Witnessed', 'is Hopeful (+2) (1 round)'. Shaken is blocked on both; Still Water (family:brain) is unchanged. The cause is the boons-have-no-family ruling, and the new behaviour is the right one (a holder could never be Witnessed before). But the builder describes the ruling only for a Body immunity, which no item in the data has, and item 1565 states 'No trait or perk in the golden table changed its line from this'. The golden line item/trait:mind_without_fog/bearer did not move, so the item lines do not try the conditions that matter. Related by reading, not run: Grudge Bearer (perks/f.ts:658 tests ctx.fam) no longer spends its once-a-fight Spite on Marked.
problems.where: packages/engine/src/condtable.ts (fam only when not a boon); packages/engine/src/effects/core.ts:115-118; spec item 1565; test/golden/conds.ts item lines

problems.title: The Fighter's Shove (Prone) now fires cond_landed twice, and logs a broken line when the target gets up at once

problems.title: The new lint misses most ways a later model would go round the primitives
problems.evidence: I appended to src/perks/a.ts: `Object.assign(u, { prone: true, braced: false })`, `u['bleed'] = 3`, `const { conds } = u; conds['slowed'] = 2`, `u.injuries.push({ loc: 'arm', side: 'left' })` (a private injury), a `for (const v of cb.units) if (<distance to at> <= 2) v.hp -= 5` private blast, `u.overwatch = {…}`, and `const id = 'rooted'` for later use. I appended to src/combat.ts: `rawBleed(t, 3); rawDazed(t, 1)` (combat.ts is on the raw-write allow list). lint-conditions and lint-foundations: 31/31 pass. The blast lint is one regex for `cb.units.filter((v) => … dist(v.pos, tile) <= r)`; the id lint reads literals only; the flag lint needs `.field =`. The plain forms (`t.prone = true`, `t.conds!.x = 2`, a literal unknown id) are caught by the lint's own self-test. I found no surviving direct write in src, apps/web or apps/server.
problems.where: packages/engine/test/lint-conditions.test.ts (FLAG_WRITE, CONDS_WRITE, the ALLOWED raw-write list, the F6 patterns)

problems.title: The validator does not check most numbers the engine reads from a row: five silent losses give 0 errors
problems.evidence: In a scratch copy of data/ I (1) added `stat_mod stat:'defence'` to Inspired, (2) removed Sharpened's `damage_mult next_attack`, (3) removed the Right Brain Debuff's two skill_mod_tag effects, (4) put `when:'always'` on Withdrawing's Defense (condtable.ts modsOf skips any stat_mod with `when`, but COND_NEEDS does not look at it), (5) misspelt Blinded's attack_mod context as 'own_attack'. tools/validate.py printed '0 errors, 0 warnings'. The engine would silently apply x1 damage, no -2, no Defense and no -4 to hit. COND_NEEDS checks one effect for 21 rows. The lint would catch (4) only; the golden table is the real guard (mutation M7, Shaken 3 -> 2 rounds, passes the validator and fails golden-conditions). The golden runs were not repeated on these five edits.

problems.title: hideAgain ignores the action's rng and throws when no game is bound
problems.evidence: magic.ts:421: `applyCond(cb, rngOf(), by, u, 'hidden', …)`. kit.ts rngOf() with no arguments takes the bound game's rng and throws 'No rng in reach' otherwise. Throwaway test: hideAgain(f.cb, unit) outside withGame throws; the old sites (`u.hidden = true`) could not. Its callers have an rng in scope (classes/k.ts:893/912 grandTurnStart(cb, rng, …), perks/b.ts:253) but cannot pass it. Nothing draws for Hidden today (no save), so draw order is unaffected; a cond_apply listener that rolls would move the live game's dice from inside a preview's scratch run.

problems.title: Ruling to question: dropping Prone by choice now ends a weapon Brace
problems.evidence: unitstate.ts rawProne sets braced = false, and setProne (toggleProne, kneel on a Command, Throw Down) goes through it. The old toggleProne left Braced on. The builder lists it and wrote it into the spec as point 3 of 'One table, one door'. The older spec text speaks only of being knocked Prone (Defender's Brace; Anchor, line 302) and treats braced and prone as interchangeable for a set weapon (line 471: 'While braced (or prone) … Moving ends it'). Consequence read from code, not run: a braced gunner who drops prone loses the Emplace +1 (data/weapons.json:512 braced_bonus, combat.ts:1043 reads att.braced only) and the Braced Auto line (physical/ranged/sets.ts:181), and pays Brace again. Pinned by golden site/drop-prone and M14.

pinMutationResult:
Commit order is right: d3f6b58 (the pin) adds only the four golden files on top of 98d8f75; 775caf6 is the engine change; the harness test/golden/conds.ts is byte-identical between the two, so the 354 moved lines come from the engine, not the harness. My own grouping of the moved keys matches the builder's table (bleeding, braced, injured, the immune/ query lines, cleanse of boons and states, restore, site, stack/hidden), with one line added (item/trait:factory_made/bearer).

15 mutations on 61f9a99, one at a time, against golden-conditions, foundations-conditions and lint-conditions; survivors also against golden-rules and targeted suites.

Caught by the golden table (8): M1 own-turn freshness removed; M2 weapon on-hit Prone bypasses the door; M7 data Shaken 3 -> 2 rounds (validator still says 0 errors); M9 flag conditions skip the immune query; M10 restoreConds without numbers; M12 injury Daze bypasses the door; M14 Prone keeps Braced; M15 Bleeding default 1 round.

Caught only by the unit tests in foundations-conditions, not by any golden table (3): M5 coming up from Downed keeps death saves; M8 hideAgain gives a new ambush entry; M11 a reveal keeps lastSeen.

Missed by everything I ran (3): M3 Stop: Prone bypasses the door; M4 Called Shot skips the injury hook and the door; M13 Unravel does not reveal a Hidden unit.

lint-conditions passed under all 15, including the bypasses (M2, M3, M12), because they used allowed primitives (setProne, rawDazed in combat.ts).
verdict:
The pin is real and the table work is sound, but it needs fixes before it merges: eight problems with evidence, none a blocker on its own, four of them medium gaps in what is listed or pinned.

- **Pin:** committed before the engine changed, harness untouched, and it catches 8 of 15 mutations directly (3 more by unit tests). It has three holes at moved sites: Stop: Prone, the Called Shot, Unravel.
- **Behaviour changes:** every re-recorded line traces to a listed ruling. Three things are not listed or are understated: Bleeding 3 rounds also triples Cut, Sweep, Sunder, Draw Cut and Pull Out; Mind Without Fog now lets Witnessed and Hopeful land; the Fighter's Shove double-fires cond_landed with a broken log line.
- **Sites going round the primitive:** none found in engine src, apps/web or apps/server. The lint would not catch a new one written with Object.assign, a bracket write, a destructured conds, a raw write inside combat.ts, a private injury push or a loop blast.
- **Determinism and saves:** no change to rng draw order found (every new applyCond site passes skipSave; the immune query draws nothing). No change to the saved state shape. Carried story conditions now load only table conditions under their keys (listed, item 1569). The one rng wart is hideAgain using the bound game's rng.
- **Area shapes:** I compared each of the nine replaced sites with its old code (iteration order, Downed and surrendered handling, the apex tile, the grid versus crow-flies reach) and found no difference.
- **`npm run check`:** validator 0 errors; engine and web types clean; screen data fresh. Engine tests 3516 passed with 2 timeouts in test/balance/step1-fit, which pass alone with --testTimeout 300000. Web tests 1001 passed with 5 failures in combat-screen.test.ts under machine load (15 to 28); that file passes 15/15 alone.
- **Environment:** the disk was full, so I used a sparse worktree with assets linked from the builder's worktree instead of `npm install`. The branch merges cleanly into the current base tip (adcc29a); it was cut from 98d8f75. The temp worktree is removed.
